other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via frequency encoding before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes category frequencies on the combined train and test dataset before splitting, leaking the test distribution of categorical variables into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in stacked cross-validation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the same KFold splits to generate out-of-fold (OOF) base model predictions and to cross-validate the meta-models. This causes target leakage during meta-model validation, because the OOF features in the meta-model's training set were generated by base models trained on data that includes the meta-model's validation set.

summary: The agent implements a solid feature engineering pipeline and stacking ensemble, but critically leaks test data into the training set in multiple ways. TF-IDF vectorization, TruncatedSVD, and frequency encoding are all applied to the combined train and test datasets before splitting. Additionally, there is subtle target leakage in the stacking implementation because the exact same KFold splits are reused for both generating base model OOF features and evaluating the meta-models.
